prompt: Two pizzas are shared equally among $5$ kids at a sleepover. How much pizza does each kid get?
hint: Sharing equally is division: $2$ pizzas $\div$ $5$ kids.

hints.text: Sharing equally is division: $2$ pizzas $\div$ $5$ kids.
Write that division as a fraction — the pizzas go on top.

explanation: Sharing $2$ pizzas equally among $5$ kids means $2 \div 5$.
A division written as a fraction puts the dividend on top: $2 \div 5 = \frac{2}{5}$.
Each kid gets $\frac{2}{5}$ of a pizza.

alternativeExplanations.title: Cut it up
steps: Slice each pizza into $5$ equal slices — that is $10$ slices in all.
$10$ slices shared by $5$ kids is $2$ slices each.
Two slices out of the five that make a pizza is $\frac{2}{5}$ ✓
